**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

This is a co-development funding agreement, not a renewing subscription. Section 14.1 fixes the Term as running from the Effective Date to the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment — a milestone-based expiry with no auto-renewal, evergreen extension, non-renewal notice window, or renewal price uplift anywhere in the document (searches for "renew"/"extend" hit only IP registrations, Permitted Liens and insurance). Article 14.2 contains termination rights only, including PB's at-will termination right in 14.2.2.

Because any continuation of the relationship would require mutual written agreement, the document effectively sits at the playbook's preferred position, and the absence of a renewal mechanic works in our favour. No redline proposed.
